info.title: Featherbone
info.description: Featherbone is a Node.js and PostgreSQL framework for building object-relational business applications from feathers: data classes whose definitions generate the database tables, the REST routes and the client. One server hosts many instances (databases), each served under its own path and carrying its own modules. Every path here is relative to the instance; data routes are generated per feather, and modules add routes of their own.

post.description: Authenticates `username` and `password` against the identity in the manager database and the caller's grant to this instance, making the local profile on first entry. Without a second factor the session is opened (cookie set) and the signed-in user is returned. When the installation (`twoFactorAuth`) or the user's organization requires a second factor, no session is opened: a confirmation code is mailed and the answer carries the masked address and the confirmation link to complete with the code. Refusals are generic ("Invalid sign in credentials.") except for lockout, session limit, maintenance and single sign-on.

200.description: Signed-in user, or the second-factor challenge

post.description: Ends the caller's session and tells every open browser instance on it (by event) that it was signed out. Answers 200 with an empty body whether or not a session existed.

"Forgot password". Flags the user account to change its password and mails a sign-in link to the address on file (making the contact from the identity when the profile has none). Refused for the system user. A mail that cannot be sent is an error.

Issues an event key for this browser instance, to send over the web socket to receive change notifications, and reports who is signed in. Works without a session (that is how the client learns whether one is open): `authorized` is then absent. The organization and administration flags are read fresh from the manager, best effort.

authorized.description: Signed-in user plus `isOrgAdmin`, `isPlatformAdmin`, `organization`, `organizationId`; absent when not signed in

eventKey.description: Key to send on the web socket

get.description: Signed-in sessions on this instance, soonest to expire first. Super users only.

403.description: Forbidden: not a super user of this instance

post.description: Deletes a session of this instance and signals its browser instances that they were signed out. Super users only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Session id, as listed by GET /sessions

403.description: Forbidden: not a super user of this instance

post.description: Changes the caller's identity password (one password for every instance the person reaches) after checking the old one; the new one must differ, be non-blank and meet `passwordLength`. Audited. A wrong old password is 401.

post.summary: Set own password and sign out
post.description: Sets the caller's identity password without the old one -- the forced change after a reset or invitation link -- clears the account's change-password flag, then signs the session out.

200.description: Changed and signed out; empty body

post.description: Updates the contact linked to the caller's user account, creating and linking one (an Employee when that feather inherits Contact) when there is none.

get.description: The caller's stored client preferences (column widths, chosen layouts and the like), or `false` when none was ever saved.

put.description: Creates or replaces the caller's profile. Send `{etag, data}` to replace an existing one (the etag must match the stored one), or the bare profile data to create one. Answers the new etag.

patch.description: Applies a JSON Patch to the caller's existing profile, guarded by its etag. Answers the new etag.

etag.description: Etag of the profile being changed

get.description: Attestation options for registering a passkey to the signed-in identity; stores a two-minute challenge. Needs a session (500 otherwise).

post.description: Verifies the attestation against the stored challenge and saves the credential to the identity. Audited.

get.description: Assertion options listing the identity's credentials, with a two-minute challenge; `{registrationRequired: true}` when it has none.

post.description: Verifies the assertion against the stored challenge and a credential the identity holds for this instance, and records the signature counter. Always answers 200; check `authenticated`.

Inbound webhook. The header named by config `webhookHeader` must carry the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed with `webhookSecret`; with either unset everything is refused. A valid call stores the body as a Notice record for module triggers to act on.

get.description: Whether the caller may perform `action` on a record (`id`) or on a feather (`feather`); `id` wins when both are given. `canCreate` is only meaningful for a feather. Super users are always authorized; an unknown id is not.

post.description: Runs SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN or MAX over the records of a feather the caller may read, filtered like a query. A money property's `amount` is totalled in base currency. Values come back positionally (`f1`, `f2`, ... in the order asked; a single aggregation is a bare number); `alias` is not used.

property.description: Property; dot notation for relations and `money.amount`

post.description: The role grants stored on one record. Takes a query-shaped body and reads only `filter.criteria[0].value` as the record id.

Marks a record as being edited by the caller from the browser instance holding `eventKey`, so other users cannot change it. Fails if another event key holds the lock; 404 for an unknown id. Locks are released by /do/unlock or when the instance's web socket closes.
Clears the caller's lock on a record (only locks held by the caller on this server node).

post.summary: Format a row or cell, or write a note on a cell
post.description: Changes one format, or the caller's own note, in a record's `meta`. Needs update authorization on the record (401 otherwise). Not an edit: the record's `updated` stamp, feather triggers and any lock are left alone, and subscribers get a `meta` change rather than `update`. Note HTML is sanitized. A user writes and clears only their own note on a cell; a note with no text left is cleared. Ordinary saves ignore `meta`.

attr.description: Column the cell is in (a property, or a relation path)

format.description: Only what is set is kept

background.description: `#rrggbb`, or a swatch: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, gray

200.description: The record's meta afterwards, or null when nothing is left

post.description: Adds a record to a subscription, so changes to it are pushed to the event key's web socket.

post.description: Renders records through a form (or the feather's default layout) to a PDF in the download folder, as the caller, and answers its name; open it with GET /pdf/{file}. Records are given by id(s) (all of one feather) or as data.

form.description: Form name; omit for the default layout

data.description: Record(s) to print instead of ids

schema.description: PDF file name in the download folder

post.description: Sends a message through the instance's configured mail service (global settings `smtpType` SMTP, or Gmail with the caller's Google authorization), attaching a PDF printed from `pdf.form` and `pdf.id(s)`/`pdf.data`, or an already generated `pdf.filename`. A failed Gmail send drops the stored Google authorization.

data.description: Record to print instead of ids

filename.description: Attachment name, or an existing file in the download folder

get.description: Sends a PDF from the download folder inline, then deletes it. No session is checked.
The Currency record that was the base currency at `effective` (default now).

get.summary: Convert an amount to base currency
get.description: Converts `amount` in `fromCurrency` to the base currency using the latest conversion on or before `effective` (default today). 404 when there is no conversion; `toCurrency` is not implemented (501).

200.description: Amount in base currency; `effective` and `baseAmount` empty

get.description: A feather (data class) from this instance's catalog with its inherited properties merged in (each marked `inheritedFrom`) and overload defaults applied; `false` when there is no such feather.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Feather name, in any case (camel-cased on the way in, e.g. `sales-order`)

get.description: A settings row's data and etag; `false` when there is none. Encrypted values are blanked for callers who may not change the row; organization-wide values are laid over the instance's.

put.description: Creates or replaces a settings row. Needs a super user, a role granted `canUpdate` on the row, or (for organization settings) an organization administrator; platform-only settings need a platform administrator. A stale `etag` is refused. Encrypted properties are encrypted; organization properties are also written to the organization.

get.description: Whether the caller may change the named settings.
The definition of every settings row that has one.

post.description: Builds a package zip of a module and its dependencies from this instance (feathers, forms, workbooks, settings, scripts and, by default, its dashboard layouts) in the download folder and answers its name.

schema.description: Zip file name in the download folder, e.g. `MyModule-v1.0.0.zip`

post.description: Installs an uploaded package zip on this server (replacing the same version) and deploys it into this instance, which is held in maintenance while it runs. Platform administrators only; audited.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A single path segment holding a `qs`-encoded query string, URL-encoded as a whole (e.g. `encodeURIComponent(qs.stringify({...}))`). Optional keys `subscription[id]`, `subscription[eventKey]` for progress.

libraries.description: npm libraries installed with the package

post.description: Runs the framework's own manifest (Core) against this instance, or against the named `databases`. Super users only.

post.description: Cancels the database backend of a running ServerProcess (an install, export, import...), marks it stopped and drops its subscriptions.

post.summary: Grant a role access to a record
post.description: Sets one role's create/read/update/delete grants on a record. Only a super user, or whoever may update the record, may change its grants; the role must exist.

actions.description: null leaves a grant as it is

get.description: The ribbon's category tabs in presentation order, with how many workbooks each holds.

put.description: Saves the complete category list in one transaction: entries with a known `id` are updated, others inserted, and missing ones removed -- refused while a workbook uses one. Names must be unique. Super users only.

get.description: Every workbook the caller may read (all for a super user), with its authorizations.
Whether the caller may read or update a workbook.
One workbook the caller may read; 404 otherwise.

put.description: Creates or updates the workbook(s) in the body, matched on each spec's own `name` (the path name is not read). Creating needs a super user; updating needs a super user or `canUpdate` on the workbook, and changing its authorizations a super user. `authorizations: false` leaves grants alone; `canUpdateSettings` is stored on the settings row the workbook opens.

delete.description: Deletes a workbook and its authorizations. Super users only.

get.description: Every shared layout for the Home tab, by sequence then name. Readable by everyone; tiles enforce permissions when they load.
One layout, or `false` when there is none.

put.description: Creates or replaces a layout named by the path. Anyone may create one; only its author or a super user may change it, and only a super user may change which layout is the default (setting it clears the others). Answers the layout id.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a layout. Its author or a super user only. `false` when there is no such layout.

get.description: Every stored metric target. Readable by everyone.

put.description: Creates or replaces one metric's target. Super users only.

basis.description: A number, or a percentage of the comparison

delete.description: Deletes one metric's target. Super users only. `false` when there was none.

get.summary: Everything this instance has help for

pages.description: The module's pages, in reading order

get.summary: Find the help page for a form or feather

supplement.description: Customer help link for the form
